d:
The Gada family celebrates Diwali, with Champaklal playfully bringing up childhood memories of Jethalal fearing bulls. Jethalal heads to Gada Electronics for Chopda Pujan, where Natu Kaka sells major appliances, pulls a prank about festival bonuses, and ends up happily receiving a double salary bonus.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
